name: File system
description: Read and write local files and folders.

conditions.description: Triggered after showing a file/folder picker when the user successfully made a selection.
Triggered after showing a file/folder picker when the user did not make a selection (including cancelling).
Check if a picker tag is available. This includes pickers remembered from prior sessions.
Test whether file system operations are supported on the current browser/platform.
Triggered upon successfully completing a file operation.

file-tag.name: File tag
file-tag.desc: Tag of the corresponding file operation.

conditions.description: Triggered when a file operation fails.

file-tag.name: File tag
file-tag.desc: Tag of the corresponding file operation.

conditions.description: Triggered upon successfully completing any file operation. The 'FileTag' expression identifies the operation.
Triggered when any file operation fails. The 'FileTag' expression identifies the operation.
Triggered when files are dragged and dropped in to the window.

type.name: Type
type.desc: Whether to check for a file or folder.

name.name: Name
name.desc: The file or folder name to check for.

case-sensitive.name: Case-sensitive
case-sensitive.desc: Whether to check the name case-sensitively. Note some file systems are case-sensitive.

conditions.description: True when running on a platform which supports known folder picker tags and desktop-only actions.

actions.display-text: Add accept type [i]{0}[/i] with file extensions [i]{1}[/i] description [i]{2}[/i]
actions.description: Add a category of files allowed to be accepted by the next file picker.

mime-type.name: MIME type
mime-type.desc: A MIME type for this category of files, such as "image/png", "image/*", or "application/octet-stream".

file-extensions.name: File extensions
file-extensions.desc: A list of file extensions allowed in this category separated by semicolons, e.g. ".png;.jpg".

description.name: Description
description.desc: A description to show to the user for this category, e.g. "Image files".

actions.display-text: Show save file picker tag [b]{0}[/b] (show accept all [i]{1}[/i], suggested name [i]{2}[/i], ID [i]{3}[/i], start in [i]{4}[/i])
actions.description: Show a save file picker, allowing the user to choose a file to write to.

picker-tag.name: Picker tag
picker-tag.desc: A string to identify this particular file picker.

show-accept-all.name: Show accept all
show-accept-all.desc: Whether to show an accept type that shows all files.

suggested-name.name: Suggested name
suggested-name.desc: A default filename to suggest saving as.

id.name: Picker ID (optional)
id.desc: An optional string to identify this picker for remembering its settings.

start-in.name: Start in
start-in.desc: The default folder to show when there are no prior remembered settings.

actions.display-text: Show open file picker tag [b]{0}[/b] (show accept all [i]{1}[/i], multiple [i]{2}[/i], ID [i]{3}[/i], start in [i]{4}[/i])
actions.description: Show a save file picker, allowing the user to choose a file to write to.

picker-tag.name: Picker tag
picker-tag.desc: A string to identify this particular file picker.

show-accept-all.name: Show accept all
show-accept-all.desc: Whether to show an accept type that shows all files.

multiple.name: Multiple
multiple.desc: Whether to allow selecting multiple files to open.

id.name: Picker ID (optional)
id.desc: An optional string to identify this picker for remembering its settings.

start-in.name: Start in
start-in.desc: The default folder to show when there are no prior remembered settings.

actions.display-text: Show folder picker tag [b]{0}[/b] mode [i]{1}[/i] (ID [i]{2}[/i], start in [i]{3}[/i])
actions.description: Show a save file picker, allowing the user to choose a file to write to.

picker-tag.name: Picker tag
picker-tag.desc: A string to identify this particular folder picker.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: The kind of access permission to request for the folder.

id.name: Picker ID (optional)
id.desc: An optional string to identify this picker for remembering its settings.

start-in.name: Start in
start-in.desc: The default folder to show when there are no prior remembered settings.

actions.display-text: Write text file for picker tag [b]{0}[/b] with content [i]{3}[/i] (folder path [i]{1}[/i], file tag [i]{2}[/i], [i]{4}[/i])
actions.description: Write a text file to a previously picked file or folder.

picker-tag.name: Picker tag
picker-tag.desc: The tag of the file picker identifying where to write a file.

folder-path.name: Folder path (optional)
folder-path.desc: When the picker was a folder or open multiple picker, the name or path to write to, e.g. "folder/file.txt".

file-tag.name: File tag (optional)
file-tag.desc: An optional tag to identify this specific file operation.

text.name: Text
text.desc: String of the text to write to the file.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Whether to overwrite the file contents or append to the existing file.

actions.display-text: Write binary file for picker tag [b]{0}[/b] with content {3} (folder path [i]{1}[/i], file tag [i]{2}[/i])
actions.description: Write binary data to a previously picked file or folder.

picker-tag.name: Picker tag
picker-tag.desc: The tag of the file picker identifying where to write a file.

folder-path.name: Folder path (optional)
folder-path.desc: When the picker was a folder or open multiple picker, the name or path to write to, e.g. "folder/file.txt".

file-tag.name: File tag (optional)
file-tag.desc: An optional tag to identify this specific file operation.

data.name: Data
data.desc: The Binary Data object to write to the file.

actions.display-text: Read text file for picker tag [b]{0}[/b] (folder path [i]{1}[/i], file tag [i]{2}[/i])
actions.description: Read a text file from a previously picked file or folder.

picker-tag.name: Picker tag
picker-tag.desc: The tag of the file picker identifying where to read a file.

folder-path.name: Folder path (optional)
folder-path.desc: When the picker was a folder or open multiple picker, the name or path to read from, e.g. "folder/file.txt".

file-tag.name: File tag (optional)
file-tag.desc: An optional tag to identify this specific file operation.

actions.display-text: Read binary file for picker tag [b]{0}[/b] to {3} (folder path [i]{1}[/i], file tag [i]{2}[/i])
actions.description: Read binary data from a previously picked file or folder.

picker-tag.name: Picker tag
picker-tag.desc: The tag of the file picker identifying where to read a file.

folder-path.name: Folder path (optional)
folder-path.desc: When the picker was a folder or open multiple picker, the name or path to read from, e.g. "folder/file.txt".

file-tag.name: File tag (optional)
file-tag.desc: An optional tag to identify this specific file operation.

data.name: Data
data.desc: The Binary Data object to read the content of the file in to.

actions.display-text: Create folder for picker tag [b]{0}[/b] at [i]{1}[/i] (file tag [i]{2}[/i])
actions.description: Create a new folder within a picked folder.

picker-tag.name: Picker tag
picker-tag.desc: The tag of the folder picker to work in.

folder-path.name: Folder path
folder-path.desc: The path of the folder to create. This can include multiple subfolders, e.g. "folder\subfolder".

file-tag.name: File tag (optional)
file-tag.desc: An optional tag to identify this specific file operation.

actions.display-text: Copy file for picker tag [b]{0}[/b] from [i]{1}[/i] to [i]{2}[/i] (file tag [i]{3}[/i])
actions.description: Copy a file within a picked folder.

picker-tag.name: Picker tag
picker-tag.desc: The tag of the folder picker to work in.

src-folder-path.name: Source path
src-folder-path.desc: The path of the source file to copy.

dest-folder-path.name: Destination path
dest-folder-path.desc: The path of the destination file where a copy is created.

file-tag.name: File tag (optional)
file-tag.desc: An optional tag to identify this specific file operation.

actions.display-text: Move file for picker tag [b]{0}[/b] from [i]{1}[/i] to [i]{2}[/i] (file tag [i]{3}[/i])
actions.description: Move (or rename) a file within a picked folder.

picker-tag.name: Picker tag
picker-tag.desc: The tag of the folder picker to work in.

src-folder-path.name: Source path
src-folder-path.desc: The path of the source file to move.

dest-folder-path.name: Destination path
dest-folder-path.desc: The path of the destination to move the file to.

file-tag.name: File tag (optional)
file-tag.desc: An optional tag to identify this specific file operation.

actions.display-text: Delete from picker tag [b]{0}[/b] path [i]{1}[/i] (recursive [i]{2}[/i], file tag [i]{3}[/i])
actions.description: Delete a file or folder within a picked folder.

picker-tag.name: Picker tag
picker-tag.desc: The tag of the folder picker to work in.

folder-path.name: Folder path
folder-path.desc: The path of the file or folder to delete.

recursive.name: Recursive
recursive.desc: When specifying a folder, whether to recursively delete the folder's content as well.

file-tag.name: File tag (optional)
file-tag.desc: An optional tag to identify this specific file operation.

actions.display-text: List content for picker tag [b]{0}[/b] path [i]{1}[/i] (recursive: [i]{2}[/i], file tag [i]{3}[/i])
actions.description: Retrieve a list of the files and folders at a given path in a folder.

picker-tag.name: Picker tag
picker-tag.desc: The tag of the folder picker to work in.

folder-path.name: Folder path
folder-path.desc: The path of the folder to list the contents for. This can be an empty string to list the contents of the picked folder.

recursive.name: Recursive
recursive.desc: Whether to list the content of all subfolders as well.

file-tag.name: File tag (optional)
file-tag.desc: An optional tag to identify this specific file operation.

actions.display-text: Shell open picker tag [b]{0}[/b] path [i]{1}[/i] (file tag [i]{2}[/i])
actions.description: Open the default associated app for a file.

picker-tag.name: Picker tag
picker-tag.desc: The tag of the folder picker to work in.

file-path.name: File path
file-path.desc: The path of the file to open.

file-tag.name: File tag (optional)
file-tag.desc: An optional tag to identify this specific file operation.

actions.display-text: Run file picker tag [b]{0}[/b] path [i]{1}[/i] arguments [i]{2}[/i] (file tag [i]{3}[/i])
actions.description: Run a file, such as executing another program.

picker-tag.name: Picker tag
picker-tag.desc: The tag of the folder picker to work in. For this action specifically, this can be left empty to specify a path that can be found on the system (e.g. "cmd.exe").

file-path.name: File path
file-path.desc: The path of the file to execute.

arguments.name: Arguments
arguments.desc: A string of any command-line arguments to pass to the executed program.

file-tag.name: File tag (optional)
file-tag.desc: An optional tag to identify this specific file operation.

expressions.description: The text content of a file after a successful read.
